best_idea: A death streak raises the respawn wait along a fixed table and resets after a quiet window, with the death XP loss capped to the current level so a death never de-levels the character.
decision_why: Take the escalating wait table and the level-capped XP loss with an 80 percent priest return, store the streak on the one character ledger to fix the in-memory defect, and drop the unused rez-penalty column until it is wired.
acceptance: Server test: deaths 1-4 inside 5 minutes give waits of 15, 30, 60 and 90 s; after a relog the fifth death still waits 120 s; a death at max level loses 0 XP; a death never takes XP below the start of the current level.
